messages:
nina: Noticing a cluster-wide spike of Pending GPU pods in ap-southeast1c starting ~09:05 UTC. Lots of 0.1-0.3 GPU jobs getting evicted immediately after schedule. Anyone else seeing this?

devin: Yep. Eviction controller shows `gpu-maint:NoSchedule` taint applied to 3 nodes in the c rack at 09:03. That wasn't in the planned list. Pending jumped from 30 -> 140 in 7m.

rachel: I recently pushed a maintenance selector change (to make rollouts regex-friendly). Looks like the selector matched _c_ as well. My mistake.

nina: This is causing fragmentation cascade: tiny pods spread across nodes, get evicted, autoscaler keeps adding warm nodes which then get tainted -> oscillation and cost burn.

infra-sre: Quick cost snapshot: extra warm spins ~1.6 GPU-hrs in last 15m. Warm startup ~5m each. Recommend pausing autoscaler and untainting affected nodes as fast mitigation.

devin: I'll remove taints from the three nodes and pause region autoscaler, then watch eviction rate. Command:
```
kubectl taint node node-apse1c-r11 gpu-maint:NoSchedule-
# pause autoscaler for ap-southeast1
```

ops-bot: Incident bot: Eviction surge acknowledged by devin at 09:18 UTC. Autoscaler paused.

nina: Untaint applied. Pending started to drain within 60-90s; eviction rate fell from ~9/min -> ~0.7/min.

rachel: I'll revert the selector change and add an explicit whitelist for racks in the rollout job, plus a canary gate: only proceed if pending/gpu < 15 and eviction_rate < 1/min. Also adding a frag-guard: do not taint racks with >50% fractional-pod occupancy.

infra-sre: I'll add a cost-hedge alert to page if warm-pool scale events exceed 1.5x baseline for >10m. Also drafting a mini-runbook: rollback-taint -> pause-autoscaler -> verify-no-driver-issues -> safe-reapply.

devin: Leaving autoscaler paused for 20m. If evictions spike again i'll re-open.

nina: Post-incident follow-ups: rachel to fix selector + canary, eng-platform to add frag-guard, infra-sre to add cost alert. Thanks team.

ops-bot: Alert cleared: Eviction rate normalized. Logged incident 2026-03-23-apse1c-frac-pack-guard. :white_check_mark:
